"""Pilot-only: last screen-variant check before locking (honest 1x5-fold GBM)."""
import time
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier, HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

T = np.loadtxt("data/pilot.csv", delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
X, y = T[:, :-1], T[:, -1]
outer = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=1)
inner = StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=2)

def screen_bstab(Xs, ys, k_per=30, thr=0.5, cap=30, n_b=64, trees=150, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    freq = np.zeros(Xs.shape[1])
    for b in range(n_b):
        idx = rng.randint(0, Xs.shape[0], Xs.shape[0])
        m = ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=trees, random_state=seed + b, n_jobs=8).fit(Xs[idx], ys[idx])
        freq[np.argsort(-m.feature_importances_)[:k_per]] += 1
    freq /= n_b
    cand = np.where(freq >= thr)[0]
    cand = cand[np.argsort(-freq[cand])]
    return cand[:cap] if len(cand) > cap else cand

gbm = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=0)
grid = {"learning_rate": [0.03, 0.1], "max_leaf_nodes": [4, 8], "min_samples_leaf": [15, 40], "max_features": [1.0, 0.5]}

for name, kw in [("k20thr.5cap20", dict(k_per=20, thr=0.5, cap=20)),
                 ("k30thr.6cap30", dict(k_per=30, thr=0.6, cap=30))]:
    t0 = time.time()
    aucs, featsets = [], []
    for tr, te in outer.split(X, y):
        idx = screen_bstab(X[tr], y[tr], **kw)
        g = GridSearchCV(clone(gbm), grid, cv=inner, scoring="roc_auc", n_jobs=-1)
        g.fit(X[tr][:, idx], y[tr])
        aucs.append(roc_auc_score(y[te], g.best_estimator_.predict_proba(X[te][:, idx])[:, 1]))
        featsets.append(len(idx))
    print(f"{name}: GBM honest {np.mean(aucs):.4f} +- {np.std(aucs):.4f}  k_in_fold={featsets}  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)", flush=Tr
